description: Attach a file from the user's computer to this tool's result so you can inspect it in your next step: a screenshot you took, a chart or page a script drew, a document, a log or a source file. Text comes back as text: up to 2,000 lines and 50 KiB, or else only the start of the file. Any other file is attached whole, as it is, with its media type, and the provider decides whether it can read it. If it can't, or the file is too large, the result says so, and that file can't be read in this session. Images over 2,000 px on their long edge can't be attached. Attached files stay in the conversation, so attach only what you need. A relative path is resolved against the working directory, and ~ is the user's home.
name: view_file
